{"source":"docs/architecture/diagrams/05-fencing-boundaries.d2","sourceDigest":"16dbf4c24154fe4854551be0aa11b2360230f8ba9bf0ca0018897d4226ca3645","nodes":[{"id":"old_coord","label":"Old coordinator
Original instance and fence"},{"id":"new_coord","label":"New coordinator
New fenced owner"},{"id":"store","label":"Authoritative ledger
Check lineage / owner / fence
inside EVERY mutation"},{"id":"gate","label":"Final broker gate
Deny new stale calls"},{"id":"old_broker","label":"Paused old broker
May retain an accepted claim"},{"id":"barrier","label":"Qualified physical stop / drain
or receiver-enforced fence"},{"id":"quiesce","label":"Quiescing scope
No replacement emission right
Conflicting disclosure withheld"},{"id":"upstream","label":"Upstream / receiver"},{"id":"note","label":"Kubernetes election, lease expiry, or a new DB fence alone
do not stop old socket writes or undo an accepted remote effect."}],"edges":[{"id":"(old_coord -> store)[0]","source":"old_coord","target":"store","label":"Stale write / refund rejected"},{"id":"(new_coord -> store)[0]","source":"new_coord","target":"store","label":"Acquire higher durable fence"},{"id":"(old_coord -> gate)[0]","source":"old_coord","target":"gate","label":"New stale request rejected"},{"id":"(store -> old_broker)[0]","source":"store","target":"old_broker","label":"Existing claim stays spent
never reset"},{"id":"(old_broker -> upstream)[0]","source":"old_broker","target":"upstream","label":"Accepted in-flight work may still occur"},{"id":"(new_coord -> quiesce)[0]","source":"new_coord","target":"quiesce","label":"Stop / receiver evidence unavailable"},{"id":"(barrier -> quiesce)[0]","source":"barrier","target":"quiesce","label":"Required before stronger takeover guarantee"},{"id":"(gate -> barrier)[0]","source":"gate","target":"barrier","label":"Actual execution retirement evidence"}],"generatedDecorations":[]}

g.title: Existing claim stays spent never reset
Accepted in-flight work may still occur
Old coordinator Original instance and fence
Authoritative ledger Check lineage / owner / fence inside EVERY mutation
Final broker gate Deny new stale calls
Paused old broker May retain an accepted claim
Qualified physical stop / drain or receiver-enforced fence
Quiescing scope No replacement emission right Conflicting disclosure withheld
Kubernetes election, lease expiry, or a new DB fence alone do not stop old socket writes or undo an accepted remote effect.

path.aria-label: Kubernetes election, lease expiry, or a new DB fence alone do not stop old socket writes or undo an accepted remote effect.
ORIGINAL SEMANTICS / CURRENT AUTHORITY / GUARDED EXECUTION
